name: Tailwind CSS
description: Enforces utility-first Tailwind patterns with design tokens and consistent styling.
content:
# Tailwind CSS Rules

- Use utility classes exclusively — no inline `style` attributes
- Use `@apply` sparingly — only for highly repeated patterns that can't be extracted as components
- Define design tokens as CSS custom properties and reference them in `tailwind.config`
- Use Tailwind's responsive prefixes (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`) — never write custom media queries
- Use `dark:` variant for dark mode styles — don't duplicate color definitions
- Group related utilities logically: layout, spacing, typography, colors, effects
- Use `clsx` or `cn()` utility for conditional class merging — avoid string concatenation
- Prefer Tailwind spacing scale (`p-4`, `gap-6`) over arbitrary values (`p-[17px]`)
- Extract repeated class patterns into reusable components, not CSS classes
- Never use raw hex or rgb color values — always use the theme palette
